verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev's SDK and dashboard support querying/filtering many runs at once (runs.list with status filters) and infrastructure like concurrency limits/keys and queues allows large numbers of items to be processed in parallel, which indirectly enables bulk-style automation. However, there is no explicit documentation of a dedicated 'batch trigger' or bulk cancel/update API for operating on many items in a single call. Missing for 10: explicit bulk/batch trigger API, bulk cancel/retry/update operations across many runs, and independent confirmation of bulk-scale usage.
